field.label: Hardware watchdog
field.help: Arm the host's own watchdog timer at every boot. If the host stops working for longer than the timeout - a hang nothing else can recover from - the timer resets the machine by itself instead of waiting for somebody to pull the power. It is disarmed at every shutdown, so turning the machine off stays off.

field.label: Timeout (seconds)
field.help: How long the host may stop before the timer resets it. watchdogd asks for this at every pat, once a second; 128 is what has run on the Sophos XGS 136 and 3300.
